e: Borrowed from Japanese 大関(おおぜき) (ōzeki).
q: Terunofuji is the first in 64 years to be promoted to ozeki after spending two tournaments as a komusubi or sekiwake and the first since the season went to six meets in 1958.
2015 May 27, “Terunofuji promoted to ozeki after victory”, in Japan Times, archived from the original on 09 May 2018:
Former ozeki Hokutenyu, who held sumo’s second-highest rank for 44 tournaments […] died of kidney cancer at a Tokyo hospital on Friday at the age of 45.
